# Precision MedTech Services, LLC

> Independent rehabilitation equipment service company in Clermont, Florida, owned and operated by Chris Senzamici, the only factory-trained independent technician in the country for Biodex/SMTI equipment (30 years as a Biodex field service engineer). Specialized Biodex repair available nationwide; physical therapy and rehabilitation equipment service throughout Florida. 35+ years of field service experience.

## Who we serve
Professional sports teams (MLB and NFL), universities and athletic departments, hospitals and health systems, PT clinics and wellness centers, NASA and research facilities, and commercial gyms and strength facilities.

## Services
- [Biodex Repair](https://www.precisionmedtechservices.com/biodex-repair/): service for all Biodex physical medicine equipment: System 4 Pro/3/2, Balance System SD, BioSway, Gait Trainer 3, NxStep, FreeStep SAS, BioStep 2, Upper Body Cycle, Sit2Stand, Squat Assist
- [Rehab Equipment Service](https://www.precisionmedtechservices.com/rehab-equipment/): Florida service for NuStep, SciFit, Landice, Matrix, PMX and BariHab equipment, treadmills, steppers, cycles, strength equipment, treatment tables and parallel bars
- [Preventive Maintenance](https://www.precisionmedtechservices.com/preventive-maintenance/): documented inspections and functional checks; Biodex nationwide, other PT equipment in Florida

## Service area
Biodex/SMTI equipment: nationwide. Physical therapy and fitness equipment: throughout Florida, including Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Miami, Gainesville, Tallahassee, Naples, Sarasota and Pensacola. Based in Clermont, Florida (Orlando area).
